Connected Hearts 0.1.2. New: a Paused label over Sora 2 when the other player opens their menu (he freezes until they return); player cards in the launcher with level, HP/MP, keyblade and location; Sora 2 rides the skateboard with his own board; Discord status with the world picture, room and level, and a Join button while hosting. Fixes: crash entering Twilight Town (Sora 2 keeps his default keyblade for now), black screens after scenes, Sora 2 pushing the player.
